evals.prompt: I changed how one of our packages behaves - see the uncommitted diff, or the last commit if the tree is clean. Update the docs to match and add the changelog entry. Do not commit.
evals.expected_output: Reads knowledge.wiki, knowledge.changelogs and packages[].path from .agents/vulcan.manifest.json; reads the changed source itself; edits the existing page that owns the topic instead of opening a duplicate; writes a YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md entry from the changelog template whose packages: list carries the npm names it covers; runs vulcan doctor, okf check --strict and the docs build it discovered, looping until all pass; nothing committed

evals.prompt: Add a changelog entry for last week's change to the repository's CI and release tooling. It touches no package. Do not commit.
evals.expected_output: One dated entry under the manifest's knowledge.changelogs, shaped by the directory's template, carrying packages: [] in its frontmatter, added to the changelog index when one lists entries; okf check --strict passes; nothing committed

evals.prompt: The docs for the first package in .agents/vulcan.manifest.json are out of date. Refresh them against the current source. No changelog entry - nothing shipped. Do not commit.
evals.expected_output: Finds the page or README that owns that package (under knowledge.wiki, or <packages[].path>/README.md when the manifest has no wiki); verifies every name, signature and default against the source under packages[].path and fixes each drift; creates no new page and no changelog entry; runs the gates; reports each claim that changed with its source file; nothing committed
